ir.name: objective_difference_with_tiezone_clamp
ir.intuition: Creates pairwise preferences by comparing objectives and applies a tie-zone constraint to filter out negligible differences, ensuring meaningful pairs with clamped weights.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    diff = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]
    tiezone_threshold = 1e-3
    # mask for strictly better pairs outside the tie zone
    mask = (diff < -tiezone_threshold)
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    # compute raw weights as negative differences, clamp minimum at zero
    raw_weights = (-diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]).clamp(min=0)
    # normalize weights to max 1 (clamp)
    weights = raw_weights.clamp(max=1.0)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'objective_difference_with_tiezone_clamp'})
